recommendations: Leave the low_risk formula unchanged. The watchlist universe is materially more speculative / higher-volatility than the main universe, so a lower mean low_risk is expected and faithful to the inputs.
Consider demoting low_risk drift in cross-group parity from FAIL to a known selection-bias finding so it stops drowning out real parity blockers in the Midday Health Check.
Treat low_risk as explanatory in the watchlist context, not punitive — surface it next to the score rather than as a tag that demotes a row.
A future improvement (not in scope here) is to normalize low_risk by sector or market cap before cross-group comparison so the universe-mix effect is removed.
